$comment: Pilot: fulfillment center operations. Outbound first, then lost hours, hours of the day, teams, inbound and inventory, with a team drill-through. UPH (units per paid hour) and % of standard are the spine; the model is templates/fulfillment/model.
name: Pilot-Fulfillment

Context Label.en: VAR d0 = CALCULATE ( MIN ( Labor[Date] ) ) VAR d1 = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Labor[Date] ) ) RETURN FORMAT ( d0, "mmm d", "en-US" ) & " – " & FORMAT ( d1, "mmm d", "en-US" ) & "  ·  " & IF ( ISFILTERED ( Teams[Shift] ), SELECTEDVALUE ( Teams[Shift], "Some" ) & " shift", "All shifts" )
Context Label.ko: VAR d0 = CALCULATE ( MIN ( Labor[Date] ) ) VAR d1 = CALCULATE ( MAX ( Labor[Date] ) ) RETURN FORMAT ( d0, "m.d" ) & " – " & FORMAT ( d1, "m.d" ) & "  ·  " & IF ( ISFILTERED ( Teams[Shift] ), SELECTEDVALUE ( Teams[Shift], "" ) & " 교대", "전체 교대" )

Std Gap.expr: VAR g = [% of Standard] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( g ), g - 1 )

Std Shortfall.expr: VAR g = [% of Standard] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( g ), 1 - g )

expr.en: VAR v = [Units Shipped] RETURN DIVIDE ( v, IF ( v >= 1E6, 1E6, IF ( v >= 1E4, 1E3, 1 ) ) )
expr.ko: VAR v = [Units Shipped] RETURN DIVIDE ( v, IF ( v >= 1E4, 1E4, 1 ) )

formatExpr.en: VAR v = [Units Shipped] RETURN IF ( v >= 1E6, "#,0.00""M""", IF ( v >= 1E4, "#,0.0""K""", "#,0" ) )

expr.en: VAR v = [Units Received] RETURN DIVIDE ( v, IF ( v >= 1E6, 1E6, IF ( v >= 1E4, 1E3, 1 ) ) )
expr.ko: VAR v = [Units Received] RETURN DIVIDE ( v, IF ( v >= 1E4, 1E4, 1 ) )

formatExpr.en: VAR v = [Units Received] RETURN IF ( v >= 1E6, "#,0.00""M""", IF ( v >= 1E4, "#,0.0""K""", "#,0" ) )

Orders Text.en: VAR o = [Orders Shipped] RETURN IF ( o >= 1E6, FORMAT ( o / 1E6, "0.00" ) & "M", FORMAT ( o, "#,0" ) ) & " orders  ·  " & FORMAT ( [Units per Order], "0.00" ) & " per order"
Orders Text.ko: VAR o = [Orders Shipped] RETURN "주문 " & IF ( o >= 1E4, FORMAT ( o / 1E4, "#,0" ) & "만", FORMAT ( o, "#,0" ) ) & "건  ·  건당 " & FORMAT ( [Units per Order], "0.00" ) & "개"

Outbound UPH Text.en: "Plan " & FORMAT ( [Outbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & "  " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Outbound UPH], [Outbound Target UPH] ) - 1, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%" )
Outbound UPH Text.ko: "계획 " & FORMAT ( [Outbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & "  " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Outbound UPH], [Outbound Target UPH] ) - 1, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%" )

First-attempt Gap.expr: VAR v = [First-attempt %] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( v ), v - 0.95 )

Inbound UPH Text.en: "Plan " & FORMAT ( [Inbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & "  " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Inbound UPH], [Inbound Target UPH] ) - 1, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%" )
Inbound UPH Text.ko: "계획 " & FORMAT ( [Inbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & "  " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Inbound UPH], [Inbound Target UPH] ) - 1, "▲0.0%;▼0.0%" )

Accuracy Gap.expr: VAR v = [Inventory Accuracy] RETURN IF ( NOT ISBLANK ( v ), v - 0.99 )

UPH Trend.expr: VAR _t = FILTER ( ADDCOLUMNS ( VALUES ( Calendar[Week Start] ), "UphV", [UPH] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [UphV] ) ) VAR _w0 = MINX ( _t, Calendar[Week Start] ) VAR _w1 = MAXX ( _t, Calendar[Week Start] ) VAR _span = MAX ( INT ( _w1 - _w0 ), 1 ) VAR _lo = MINX ( _t, [UphV] ) VAR _hi = MAXX ( _t, [UphV] ) VAR _rng = IF ( _hi = _lo, 1, _hi - _lo ) VAR _pts = CONCATENATEX ( _t, FORMAT ( 3 + INT ( Calendar[Week Start] - _w0 ) * 94 / _span, "0.0", "en-US" ) & "," & FORMAT ( 21 - ( [UphV] - _lo ) * 18 / _rng, "0.0", "en-US" ), " ", Calendar[Week Start], ASC ) VAR _end = MAXX ( FILTER ( _t, Calendar[Week Start] = _w1 ), [UphV] ) VAR _dot = SUBSTITUTE ( IF ( [% of Standard] < 1, "@neg", "@pos" ), "#", "%23" ) VAR _stroke = SUBSTITUTE ( "@ink3", "#", "%23" ) RETURN IF ( COUNTROWS ( _t ) > 1, "data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='24' viewBox='0 0 100 24'><polyline fill='none' stroke='" & _stroke & "' stroke-width='1.4' stroke-linejoin='round' stroke-linecap='round' points='" & _pts & "'/><circle cx='97' cy='" & FORMAT ( 21 - ( _end - _lo ) * 18 / _rng, "0.0", "en-US" ) & "' r='2.4' fill='" & _dot & "'/></svg>" )

Headline Outbound.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Teams[Team] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Outbound Std Gap] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [Outbound Std Gap], ASC ) RETURN "Outbound UPH " & FORMAT ( [Outbound UPH], "#,0.0" ) & " (plan " & FORMAT ( [Outbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & ")  ·  on-time ship " & FORMAT ( [On-time Ship %], "0.0%" ) & "  ·  furthest below standard: " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Teams[Team], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )
Headline Outbound.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Teams[Team] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Outbound Std Gap] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [Outbound Std Gap], ASC ) RETURN "출고 UPH " & FORMAT ( [Outbound UPH], "#,0.0" ) & " (계획 " & FORMAT ( [Outbound Target UPH], "#,0.0" ) & ")  ·  정시 출고 " & FORMAT ( [On-time Ship %], "0.0%" ) & "  ·  표준 대비 가장 낮은 팀 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Teams[Team], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )

Headline Loss.en: VAR lost = [Hours Lost] VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Processes[Process] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Hours Lost] ) ) VAR top1 = TOPN ( 1, t, [Hours Lost], DESC ) RETURN FORMAT ( lost, "#,0" ) & " hours lost vs standard  ·  idle " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Idle Hours], lost ), "0%" ) & ", indirect " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Indirect Hours], lost ), "0%" ) & ", slow work " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Hours Below Standard], lost ), "0%" ) & "  ·  most in " & CONCATENATEX ( top1, Processes[Process], ", " )
Headline Loss.ko: VAR lost = [Hours Lost] VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Processes[Process] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Hours Lost] ) ) VAR top1 = TOPN ( 1, t, [Hours Lost], DESC ) RETURN "표준 대비 손실 " & FORMAT ( lost, "#,0" ) & "시간  ·  대기 " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Idle Hours], lost ), "0%" ) & ", 간접 " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Indirect Hours], lost ), "0%" ) & ", 표준 미달 작업 " & FORMAT ( DIVIDE ( [Hours Below Standard], lost ), "0%" ) & "  ·  가장 큰 공정 " & CONCATENATEX ( top1, Processes[Process], ", " )

Headline Hours.en: VAR t = FILTER ( CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( Processes[Process] ), VALUES ( Hours[Hour Label] ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [% of Standard], ASC ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [% of Standard], DESC ) RETURN "Slowest: " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Processes[Process] & " at " & Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" ) & " of standard  ·  fastest: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, Processes[Process] & " at " & Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )
Headline Hours.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( CROSSJOIN ( VALUES ( Processes[Process] ), VALUES ( Hours[Hour Label] ) ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, t, [% of Standard], ASC ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, t, [% of Standard], DESC ) RETURN "가장 느림 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Processes[Process] & " " & Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " 표준의 " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" ) & "  ·  가장 빠름 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, Processes[Process] & " " & Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )

Headline Teams.en: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Teams[Team] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR newt = FILTER ( t, [New Hire Share] >= 0.2 ) RETURN "Below standard: " & COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( t, [% of Standard] < 1 ) ) & " of " & COUNTROWS ( t ) & " teams  ·  teams with 20%+ new hires work at " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [% of Standard], newt ), "0%" ) & " of standard, the rest at " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [% of Standard], EXCEPT ( t, newt ) ), "0%" )
Headline Teams.ko: VAR t = FILTER ( VALUES ( Teams[Team] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR newt = FILTER ( t, [New Hire Share] >= 0.2 ) RETURN "표준 미달 " & COUNTROWS ( FILTER ( t, [% of Standard] < 1 ) ) & "개 팀 / " & COUNTROWS ( t ) & "개  ·  신규 인력 20% 이상인 팀은 표준의 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [% of Standard], newt ), "0%" ) & ", 나머지는 " & FORMAT ( CALCULATE ( [% of Standard], EXCEPT ( t, newt ) ), "0%" )

Headline Inbound.en: VAR late = CALCULATE ( [Dock-to-Stock Hours], Receipts[Arrival Band] = "≥ 16:00" ) VAR z = FILTER ( VALUES ( Zones[Zone] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Inventory Accuracy] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, z, [Inventory Accuracy], ASC ) RETURN "Dock-to-stock " & FORMAT ( [Dock-to-Stock Hours], "0.0" ) & "h, " & FORMAT ( late, "0.0" ) & "h for arrivals after 16:00  ·  inventory accuracy " & FORMAT ( [Inventory Accuracy], "0.0%" ) & ", lowest " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Zones[Zone], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [Inventory Accuracy] ), "0.0%" )
Headline Inbound.ko: VAR late = CALCULATE ( [Dock-to-Stock Hours], Receipts[Arrival Band] = "≥ 16:00" ) VAR z = FILTER ( VALUES ( Zones[Zone] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [Inventory Accuracy] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, z, [Inventory Accuracy], ASC ) RETURN "입고~적치 " & FORMAT ( [Dock-to-Stock Hours], "0.0" ) & "시간, 16시 이후 도착분은 " & FORMAT ( late, "0.0" ) & "시간  ·  재고 정확도 " & FORMAT ( [Inventory Accuracy], "0.0%" ) & ", 가장 낮은 구역 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Zones[Zone], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [Inventory Accuracy] ), "0.0%" )

Headline Travel.en: VAR z = FILTER ( VALUES ( Zones[Zone] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [DPU] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, z, [DPU], DESC ) RETURN "Pick travel " & FORMAT ( [Pick DPU], "0.0" ) & " m per unit (plan " & FORMAT ( [DPU Target], "0.0" ) & ")  ·  single-unit orders " & FORMAT ( [Single-unit Share], "0%" ) & " of orders  ·  farthest zone: " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, Zones[Zone], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [DPU] ), "0.0" ) & " m"
Headline Travel.ko: VAR z = FILTER ( VALUES ( Zones[Zone] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [DPU] ) ) VAR hi = TOPN ( 1, z, [DPU], DESC ) RETURN "집품 이동 " & FORMAT ( [Pick DPU], "0.0" ) & "m/유닛 (목표 " & FORMAT ( [DPU Target], "0.0" ) & ")  ·  단일 수량 주문 " & FORMAT ( [Single-unit Share], "0%" ) & "  ·  가장 먼 구역 " & CONCATENATEX ( hi, Zones[Zone], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MAXX ( hi, [DPU] ), "0.0" ) & "m"

Headline Team Detail.en: VAR h = FILTER ( VALUES ( Hours[Hour Label] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, h, [% of Standard], ASC ) RETURN SELECTEDVALUE ( Teams[Team], "All teams" ) & "  ·  " & FORMAT ( [% of Standard], "0%" ) & " of standard  ·  slowest hour " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )
Headline Team Detail.ko: VAR h = FILTER ( VALUES ( Hours[Hour Label] ), NOT ISBLANK ( [% of Standard] ) ) VAR lo = TOPN ( 1, h, [% of Standard], ASC ) RETURN SELECTEDVALUE ( Teams[Team], "전체 팀" ) & "  ·  표준의 " & FORMAT ( [% of Standard], "0%" ) & "  ·  가장 느린 시간대 " & CONCATENATEX ( lo, Hours[Hour Label], ", " ) & " " & FORMAT ( MINX ( lo, [% of Standard] ), "0%" )
